title: A Coordinate System for Collatz Dynamics
notes: Compiled 3 July 2026, University of Southampton. READ 20 September 2026 from the full text supplied by Philippe; arxiv.org is blocked by this environment's egress policy. IT SUPERSEDES THE COLLATZ-SIDE FRAMING OF THIS SESSION'S BRIDGE WORK, and the correspondence is exact -- verified here on odd n < 2e5 and on the Mersenne rows to a = 120. Every odd n has a unique n + 1 = lambda 2^a 3^b with gcd(lambda,6) = 1, a >= 1; her (lambda, a, b) is precisely (the 6-free part of x+1, v_2(x+1), v_3(x+1)). Then: her Theorem 3.6 and Proposition 3.11, the diagonal flow (a,b) -> (a-1,b+1) multiplying n+1 by exactly 3/2, IS the statement that u = x+1 conjugates the odd shortcut step to u -> 3u/2, which was this session's tick-1 core. Her Corollary 3.9, a-1 diagonal steps to the boundary a = 1, is Hercher's Lemma 8 run length in coordinates. Her Corollary 3.7, v_2(3n+1) = 1 in the interior, is the same fact. Her row index k = a + b preserved is 'v_2 + v_3 is a first integral', and her lambda being preserved along the flow is the conserved 6-free part -- so the whole six-free-invariant direction of the 20 September prime fan-out is this paper and must be recorded as NOT NEW. Her Proposition 3.10, v_2(3n+1) = 1 + v_2(lambda 3^(b+1) - 1) at the boundary, is the LTE continuation statement. Her Section 5.1 names column b = 0 of the principal skeleton L_1 as the Mersenne numbers and b = 1 as the Thabit numbers, and her row k of L_1 traversed from (a,0) gives the elements 2^(a-j) 3^j - 1, which is IDENTICAL to the closed form T^j(2^a - 1) = 3^j 2^(a-j) - 1 recorded in J-repunit-floor-power-is-closed-form. Her Section 1.3.3 notes the 3/2 flow's link to Flatto's beta-transformation and Mahler's powers of 3/2 as 'a structural feature rather than a technical tool', with whether it gives leverage an open question -- the same position as the laboratory's Mahler cluster in negative_knowledge.md, reached independently. WHAT IT DOES NOT CONTAIN. The paper is pure Collatz. There is no Juggler, no floor-power map, and nothing on the exponent-floor transport, so J-lemma-eight-is-the-exponent-valuation's Juggler half (exactRun(n) = v_2(e(n)), HasPowTwoDepth, the N^(2^-k) against 2^(-k) N density contrast, the monochrome fibre), the Juggler floor-power closed forms for floor((2^a-1)^(3/2)), the 3x-1 verification floor and its period bound, and the negative-side window all stand. HER OPEN PROBLEM (2) ANSWERS A LAB QUESTION: for the pn+1 map, pn + 1 = lambda 2^a p^(b+1) - (p-1), so the coordinate system needs p - 1 to be a power of two, and p = 3 is the unique case with p - 1 = 2 that preserves the weight a + b. That is the general-exponent-family direction, answered. HER OPEN PROBLEM (5) IS THE LABORATORY'S TERRITORY: she asks for the relationship between Knight's parity-vector combinatorics and skeleton geometry and states it has not been investigated -- Papers A and B are parity-vector papers, so the lab is positioned to answer it. Her own new content, which is not ours and which we do not claim: Theorem 4.1 and the Complete Covering Theorem 4.2, that rows k = 2 mod 4 with k >= 6 of L_1 contain no primes and that this is the unique completely obstructed class, by difference of squares and divisibility by 5.
